$comment: BUILD-TIME REFERENCE ONLY. Zdroj pravdy je OrganisationBrandKitSchema v packages/shared-types/src/schemas/organisation.ts (Zod). Tento súbor je zladený s Zod tvarom (ploché polia, bez vnorených colors/typography) a je exportovaný v @inventario/design-tokens pre konzumentov mimo TS (napr. JSON Schema validátory, dokumentácia). Pri zmene Zod schémy zladiť aj tento súbor. ADR-0028.
title: Inventario Brand Kit
description: Per-tenant brand customization payload. Covers ONLY the brand layer of design tokens — primitive and semantic layers are not overridable per BRAND.md §8. WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1) is enforced server-side on primary+primaryFg and accent+accentFg pairs. Logo must be HTTPS PNG/JPEG/WEBP — not SVG (pdf-lib limitation). Colors and font are Pro+ only; logo is available on all plans.

oneOf.description: HTTPS URL to tenant logo. PNG/JPEG/WEBP, recommended 256x256 px, not SVG (PDF rendering limitation). Available on all plans.
HTTPS URL to tenant favicon. Application in v2 (field exists in schema, not yet wired in runtime).
Primary brand color. Overrides --inv-brand-primary. WCAG contrast with primaryFg >= 4.5:1 required. Pro+ only.
Foreground on primary (typically white). Overrides --inv-brand-primary-fg. Pro+ only.
Accent color. Overrides --inv-brand-accent. WCAG contrast with accentFg >= 4.5:1 required. Pro+ only.
Foreground on accent (typically white). Overrides --inv-brand-accent-fg. Pro+ only.
Logo accent dot color. Overrides --inv-brand-logo-dot. Defaults to accent at runtime if null. Pro+ only.
Font family stack for sans-serif text. Must end with a generic fallback (sans-serif). Pro+ only.

HexColor.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB format. Case-insensitive (#1a2d47 and #1A2D47 both valid).
